summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-6 reverse stock split approved at an EGM on June 8, 2026, effective June 29, 2026. The par value increased from $0.00016 to $0.00096 per share; fractional shares are rounded up. No transaction, premium, or board recommendation is involved. The filing is a routine corporate action to maintain Nasdaq compliance, not a special situation.
